# U60: An admin makes someone an admin on Access and takes it back: Add an admin, find Rhea, her row and her page say so, Undo; Remove as admin on Grace asks first; stopping being an admin yourself offers no Undo; the only admin has no button; each change is logged

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `ADMIN`, `WORKSPACE-ADMIN`, `CHANGE-LOG`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U60

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Add an admin” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “access”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Add an admin” button.
- _Note:_ Find-and-pick (FS1): open it, type, choose.
- **Step.** Press the “Choose a person” button in the “Add an admin” dialog.
- **Step.** Type “rhea” into a search field in the “Add an admin” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Rhea Kapoor” option in the “Add an admin” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “picked”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Make Rhea an admin” button in the “Add an admin” dialog.
- **Check:** “Rhea Kapoor is an admin” is shown.
- **Check:** The words “Rhea Kapoor” in the “Admins” list shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) there are 4 of a list item in the “Admins” list (else: Rhea is not listed with the admins).
- Go to `/people/rhea` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if Rhea’s page does not say she is an admin.
- _Note:_ Undo, from the toast that said so: made again from Access, then undone.
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Remove as admin: Rhea Kapoor” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Yes, remove” button in the “Remove as admin: Rhea Kapoor” group.
- **Check:** “Rhea Kapoor is no longer an admin” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the button in the message that pops up showing “Undo”.
- **Check:** “Rhea Kapoor is an admin again” is shown.
- _Note:_ Remove Grace, asked in place first.
- **Step.** Press the “Remove as admin: Grace Achterberg” button.
- **Check:** “Stop Grace being an admin? They keep their goals and history.” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “remove”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Yes, remove” button in the “Remove as admin: Grace Achterberg” group.
- **Check:** “Grace Achterberg is no longer an admin” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if admin changes are not saved and logged: made logged {madeLogged}, Grace admin {a value worked out in the journey}, Rhea admin {a value worked out in the journey}, {a value worked out in the journey} logged.
- _Note:_ Your own row: Rhea stops being an admin; once her rights are gone she can't give them back, so there's no Undo.
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Stop being an admin” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Yes, remove” button in the “Stop being an admin” group.
- **Check:** “You’re no longer an admin” is shown.
- **Check:** (`own`) it fails if removing your own admin rights offers Undo ({ownUndo}) or does not save.
- _Note:_ The only admin has no button: leave Amara alone as admin.
- Reload the page.
- **Check:** A list item in the “Admins” list shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the only admin is offered a way to stop being one.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
